verses.t: Leaving my day’s meditation on Vulture’s Peak Mountain, I saw an elephant on the riverbank having just come up from his bath.
A man, taking a pole with a hook, asked the elephant, “Give me your foot.” The elephant presented his foot, and the man mounted him.
Seeing a wild beast so tamed, submitting to human control, my mind became serene: that is why I’ve gone to the forest!
